selection.ownership: Cloudflare, Inc., San Francisco, California, United States. Global Workers API at api.cloudflare.com, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Cloudflare API token Bearer auth, GET /user/tokens/verify, GET /accounts, GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/workers, GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts, Cloudflare Inc. US identity, Thanksgiving 2023 Atlassian/Okta intrusion, August 2025 Salesloft Drift Salesforce CRM exposure, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical incidents are waived; no current unresolved Cloudflare Workers API compromise found. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: Thanksgiving 2023 self-hosted Atlassian intrusion via unrotated Okta credentials; August 2025 Salesloft Drift access to Cloudflare Salesforce CRM records. Cloudflare reported no customer data or Cloudflare services/infrastructure compromise in either event.
exception.remediation: Atlassian access terminated 2023-11-24; CrowdStrike forensics completed; Okta tokens rotated. Drift/Salesforce tokens invalidated and customers notified 2025-09-02.
exception.residualRisk: Historical third-party SaaS exposure remains; live authentication unverified.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for these Cloudflare Workers read operations.
exception.usefulness: Token verify, account list, and Worker/script reads provide useful authenticated Workers access while preserving provider JSON contracts.

research.searchCoverage: Official Cloudflare Workers REST at api.cloudflare.com/client/v4, Bearer API tokens, account ID path segments, envelope errors, US operator identity, and dated Thanksgiving 2023 plus Salesloft Drift 2025 coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13.

incidents.affectedData: Internal Atlassian/source systems; CrowdStrike and Cloudflare reported no customer data or production customer systems impacted.
incidents.remediation: Threat actor access terminated 2023-11-24; CrowdStrike investigation; credential rotation after the related Okta event.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical internal tooling exposure; not an unresolved Workers API compromise.

incidents.affectedProduct: Cloudflare Salesforce tenant via Salesloft Drift
incidents.affectedData: Salesforce CRM/support records; Cloudflare stated no Cloudflare services or infrastructure were compromised.
incidents.status: confirmed historical third-party CRM access; remediated
incidents.remediation: Stolen Drift/Salesforce credentials invalidated; customers notified.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical CRM data exposure; not a Workers API platform compromise.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
